label: preparing
what: A privately funded jubilee gathering in the great hall, very likely celebrating my forty years as mayor, disguised in my appointments as an eighteen hundred lighting inspection. Baker explicitly reported 184 jubilee loaves toward a 200-loaf hall order; lantern arrangements and Builder's exact-time inspection support an organised celebration. Secretary manages the revised appointment, Innkeeper the hall arrangements, and Builder the inspection and hay support. Freight's payment to Innkeeper suggests financial help; Neighbour's scheduled tea may help occupy me, though knowing involvement is less certain.
